Upgraded Noir's arkworks dependencies from `0.4.x` to `0.5.0`, with compatibility support for the older versions used by external crypto libraries in tests.

- `acvm-repo/acvm/Cargo.toml`: added `ark-bn254-v04` (`ark-bn254 ^0.4.0`) and `ark-ff-v04` (`ark-ff ^0.4.0`) for bridging to `zkhash`; also bumped the existing `ark-bls12-381` dev-dep to `^0.5.0` so the `bls12_381_circuit` test's `GenericFieldElement<ark_bls12_381::Fr>` uses the same 0.5 `PrimeField`.
